references.text: Abraham mentions his servant Eliezer of Damascus, who is likely the same servant referred to here as 'the oldest in his household, who had charge of all that he owned'.
Parallel to a trusted servant given authority over everything his master owns, just as Abraham's servant had charge of all he possessed.
Jacob asks Joseph to place his hand under his thigh and swear an oath, in the same way Abraham asked his servant to swear here.
Refers to the solemn oath God swore to Abraham, which can be connected to the formal oath Abraham asked his servant to take.
This is the direct continuation of the same event where the servant performs the required gesture and takes an oath.
